standard.summary: 训练时随机丢掉整句 caption 或部分 tag。
standard.effect: 能降低模型对固定文字的依赖，提升触发词和视觉特征的鲁棒性。
standard.whenToUse: caption 过密、tag 重复、模型过度依赖文本而视觉泛化差时可以小幅开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据量很小、caption 本身已经很弱，或已经缓存固定文本编码器输出时谨慎。

standard_en.summary: Randomly drops a whole caption, or some of its tags, during training.
standard_en.effect: Reduces the model's dependence on fixed text and makes trigger words and visual features more robust.
standard_en.whenToUse: A small amount helps when captions are too dense, tags repeat, or the model leans on text so heavily that visual generalisation suffers.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Be careful with very little data, with captions that are already weak, or when a fixed text-encoder output is already cached.

advanced.principle: Caption dropout 是条件扰动正则化。它让同一图像在不同文本条件下参与训练。
advanced.intervention: 介入 batch 采样前的 caption 生成，不直接修改图像 latent。
advanced.expectedImpact: 降低文本过拟合；过高会让模型学不到关键条件绑定。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 cache_text_encoder_outputs 冲突或需要多变体缓存；比例应从低值开始。

advanced_en.principle: Caption dropout is conditional-perturbation regularization: it lets the same image train under different text conditions.
advanced_en.intervention: Intervenes in caption generation before batch sampling; does not modify image latents directly.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Reduces text overfitting; too high a rate and the model fails to learn key condition bindings.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Conflicts with cache_text_encoder_outputs or requires multi-variant caching; start the rate low.
